00067 void DecayUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00068 {
00069     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00070     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00071     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00072     float* decaySamples = inputs[DecayTime].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00073     float newDecayTime = *decaySamples;
00074     
00075     if(newDecayTime != currentDecayTime)
00076     {
00077         float next_b1 = newDecayTime == 0.f ? 0.f : (float)exp(log001 / (newDecayTime * UGen::getSampleRate()));
00078         float b1_slope = (next_b1 - b1) * UGen::getSlopeFactor();
00079         currentDecayTime = newDecayTime;
00080         
00081         while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00082         {
00083             float y0 = *inputSamples++; 
00084             *outputSamples++ = y1 = y0 + b1 * y1;
00085             b1 += b1_slope;
00086         }
00087     }
00088     else
00089     {
00090         while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00091         {
00092             float y0 = *inputSamples++; 
00093             *outputSamples++ = y1 = y0 + b1 * y1;
00094         }
00095     }
00096     
00097     y1 = zap(y1); // denormal!
00098 }

00100 void DecayUGenInternalK::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00101 {
00102     const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();
00103     unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;
00104     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00105     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00106     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00107     float* decaySamples = inputs[DecayTime].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00108     float newDecayTime = *decaySamples;
00109     
00110     int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;
00111     
00112     if(newDecayTime != currentDecayTime)
00113     {
00114         float next_b1 = newDecayTime == 0.f ? 0.f : (float)exp(log001 * krBlockSize / (newDecayTime * UGen::getSampleRate()));
00115         float b1_slope = (next_b1 - b1) * UGen::getSlopeFactor() * krBlockSize;
00116         currentDecayTime = newDecayTime;
00117                 
00118         while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00119         {
00120             float nextValue = value;
00121             if(numKrSamples == 0)           
00122             {
00123                 b1 += b1_slope;
00124                 float y0 = *inputSamples; 
00125                 nextValue = y1 = y0 + b1 * y1;
00126             }
00127             
00128             numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;
00129             
00130             blockPosition       += numKrSamples;
00131             inputSamples        += numKrSamples;
00132             
00133             if(nextValue == value)
00134             {
00135                 while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00136                 {
00137                     *outputSamples++ = nextValue;
00138                     --numSamplesToProcess;
00139                     --numKrSamples;
00140                 }
00141             } 
00142             else
00143             {
00144                 float valueSlope = (nextValue - value) * UGen::getControlSlopeFactor();
00145                 
00146                 while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00147                 {
00148                     *outputSamples++ = value;
00149                     value += valueSlope;
00150                     --numSamplesToProcess;
00151                     --numKrSamples;
00152                 }
00153                 
00154                 value = nextValue;
00155             }
00156         }
00157         
00158         b1 = next_b1;
00159         
00160     }
00161     else
00162     {
00163         while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00164         {
00165             float nextValue = value;
00166             if(numKrSamples == 0)           
00167             {
00168                 float y0 = *inputSamples; 
00169                 nextValue = y1 = y0 + b1 * y1;
00170             }
00171             
00172             numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;
00173             
00174             blockPosition       += numKrSamples;
00175             inputSamples        += numKrSamples;
00176             
00177             if(nextValue == value)
00178             {
00179                 while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00180                 {
00181                     *outputSamples++ = nextValue;
00182                     --numSamplesToProcess;
00183                     --numKrSamples;
00184                 }
00185             } 
00186             else
00187             {
00188                 float valueSlope = (nextValue - value) * UGen::getControlSlopeFactor();
00189                 
00190                 while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00191                 {
00192                     *outputSamples++ = value;
00193                     value += valueSlope;
00194                     --numSamplesToProcess;
00195                     --numKrSamples;
00196                 }
00197                 
00198                 value = nextValue;
00199             }
00200         }
00201     }
00202     
00203     y1 = zap(y1);
00204 }
